def load_volume(fragment_dir):
    slices = []
    for i in SLICES:
        slice_path = os.path.join(fragment_dir, "surface_volume", f"{i:02d}.tif")
        slices.append(tifffile.imread(slice_path))
    return np.stack(slices, axis=-1).astype(np.float32)


class InkDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, fragment_dirs, patch_size, transform=None):
        self.patches = []
        self.transform = transform

        for frag_dir in fragment_dirs:
            image = load_volume(frag_dir)
            mask = cv2.imread(
                os.path.join(frag_dir, "inklabels.png"), cv2.IMREAD_GRAYSCALE
            )
            frag_mask = cv2.imread(
                os.path.join(frag_dir, "mask.png"), cv2.IMREAD_GRAYSCALE
            )
            mask = ((mask > 0) & (frag_mask > 0)).astype(np.float32)

            H, W = image.shape[:2]
            for y in range(0, H, patch_size):
                for x in range(0, W, patch_size):
                    if y + patch_size > H or x + patch_size > W:
                        continue
                    self.patches.append(
                        (
                            image[y : y + patch_size, x : x + patch_size],
                            mask[y : y + patch_size, x : x + patch_size],
                        )
                    )

class PapyrusDataset(Dataset):

        for dir in frag_dirs:

                target = (ink & mask).astype(np.float32)

            H, W = mip.shape
            pad_h = (patch_size - H % patch_size) % patch_size
            pad_w = (patch_size - W % patch_size) % patch_size
            self.pad_h = pad_h
            self.pad_w = pad_w
            self.mip_pad = np.pad(mip, ((0, pad_h), (0, pad_w)), "constant")
            self.target_pad = np.pad(target, ((0, pad_h), (0, pad_w)), "constant")
            self.mask_pad = np.pad(mask, ((0, pad_h), (0, pad_w)), "constant")

            self.coords = []

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.coords)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        i, j = self.coords[idx]
        img = self.mip_pad[i : i + patch_size, j : j + patch_size]
        target = self.target_pad[i : i + patch_size, j : j + patch_size]
        mask = self.mask_pad[i : i + patch_size, j : j + patch_size]

        if self.transform:
            aug = self.transform(image=img, mask=target)
            img, target = aug["image"], aug["mask"]
            return (img.float(), target.float(), torch.tensor(mask).bool())
        else:
            return (
                torch.tensor(img[None]).float(),
                torch.tensor(target).float(),
                torch.tensor(mask).bool(),
            )

class UNet(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.encoder1 = self.conv_block(NUM_SLICES, 64)
        self.encoder2 = self.conv_block(64, 128)
        self.encoder3 = self.conv_block(128, 256)
        self.encoder4 = self.conv_block(256, 512)
        self.pool = nn.MaxPool2d(2)

        self.bottleneck = self.conv_block(512, 1024)

        self.upconv4 = nn.ConvTranspose2d(1024, 512, 2, 2)
        self.decoder4 = self.conv_block(1024, 512)
        self.upconv3 = nn.ConvTranspose2d(512, 256, 2, 2)
        self.decoder3 = self.conv_block(512, 256)
        self.upconv2 = nn.ConvTranspose2d(256, 128, 2, 2)
        self.decoder2 = self.conv_block(256, 128)
        self.upconv1 = nn.ConvTranspose2d(128, 64, 2, 2)
        self.decoder1 = self.conv_block(128, 64)

        self.final = nn.Conv2d(64, 1, 1)

    def conv_block(self, in_c, out_c):
        return nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(in_c, out_c, 3, padding=1),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(out_c),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(out_c, out_c, 3, padding=1),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(out_c),
            nn.ReLU(),
        )

    def forward(self, x):
        e1 = self.encoder1(x)
        e2 = self.encoder2(self.pool(e1))
        e3 = self.encoder3(self.pool(e2))
        e4 = self.encoder4(self.pool(e3))

        bn = self.bottleneck(self.pool(e4))

        d4 = self.decoder4(torch.cat([self.upconv4(bn), e4], 1))
        d3 = self.decoder3(torch.cat([self.upconv3(d4), e3], 1))
        d2 = self.decoder2(torch.cat([self.upconv2(d3), e2], 1))
        d1 = self.decoder1(torch.cat([self.upconv1(d2), e1], 1))
        return self.final(d1)


class InkDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, fragments, transform=None):
        self.fragments = fragments
        self.transform = transform
        self.volumes = []
        self.masks = []
        self.labels = []

        for path in fragments:
            volume = []
            for i in range(20, 51):
                img = imread(f"{path}/surface_volume/{i:02d}.tif")
                volume.append(img.astype(np.float32))
            volume = np.stack(volume, axis=-1)
            volume = (volume - volume.mean()) / (volume.std() + 1e-6)

            mask = imread(f"{path}/mask.png")[..., 0] > 0
            label = (
                imread(f"{path}/inklabels.png")[..., 0] > 0 if "train" in path else None
            )

            self.volumes.append(volume)
            self.masks.append(mask)
            self.labels.append(label)

    def __len__(self):
        return sum(m.sum() for m in self.masks) // 1000

    def __getitem__(self, _):
        frag_idx = np.random.randint(len(self.volumes))
        volume = self.volumes[frag_idx]
        mask = self.masks[frag_idx]
        label = self.labels[frag_idx]

        ys, xs = np.where(mask)
        idx = np.random.randint(len(ys))
        y, x = ys[idx], xs[idx]

        y0 = max(0, y - PATCH_SIZE // 2)
        x0 = max(0, x - PATCH_SIZE // 2)
        y1 = y0 + PATCH_SIZE
        x1 = x0 + PATCH_SIZE

        if y1 > volume.shape[0]:
            y1 = volume.shape[0]
            y0 = y1 - PATCH_SIZE
        if x1 > volume.shape[1]:
            x1 = volume.shape[1]
            x0 = x1 - PATCH_SIZE

        patch = volume[y0:y1, x0:x1]  # Keep HWC format
        lbl_patch = (
            label[y0:y1, x0:x1]
            if label is not None
            else np.zeros((PATCH_SIZE, PATCH_SIZE))
        )

        if self.transform:
            aug = self.transform(image=patch, mask=lbl_patch)
            patch = aug["image"]
            lbl_patch = aug["mask"]

        return patch, lbl_patch.float()

import os
import numpy as np

import torch.nn.functional as F
from torch.utils.data import Dataset, DataLoader
from tifffile import imread
from PIL import Image
import pandas as pd

# Config
SLICE_START = 27
NUM_SLICES = 11
PATCH_SIZE = 256
BATCH_SIZE = 32
EPOCHS = 3
THRESHOLD = 0.4
OVERLAP = 128
DEVICE = "cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu"


class CombinedLoss(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, beta=0.5, smooth=1e-6):
        super().__init__()
        self.beta = beta
        self.smooth = smooth

    def forward(self, y_pred, y_true):
        # Binary cross-entropy
        bce = F.binary_cross_entropy_with_logits(y_pred, y_true)

        # F-beta calculation
        y_prob = torch.sigmoid(y_pred)
        tp = torch.sum(y_true * y_prob)
        fp = torch.sum((1 - y_true) * y_prob)
        fn = torch.sum(y_true * (1 - y_prob))

        precision = tp / (tp + fp + self.smooth)
        recall = tp / (tp + fn + self.smooth)
        f_beta = (
            (1 + self.beta**2)
            * (precision * recall)
            / (self.beta**2 * precision + recall + self.smooth)
        )
        f_loss = 1 - f_beta

        return 0.7 * bce + 0.3 * f_loss


class ScrollDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, fragments, is_train=True):
        self.is_train = is_train
        self.patches = []
        for frag in fragments:
            mask = np.array(Image.open(f"input/train/{frag}/mask.png"))
            if is_train:
                label = np.array(Image.open(f"input/train/{frag}/inklabels.png"))
            slices = []
            for i in range(SLICE_START, SLICE_START + NUM_SLICES):
                tif = imread(f"input/train/{frag}/surface_volume/{i:02}.tif")
                slices.append(tif)
            volume = np.stack(slices, axis=2)
            for y in range(0, volume.shape[0], PATCH_SIZE):
                for x in range(0, volume.shape[1], PATCH_SIZE):
                    if is_train:
                        patch_label = label[y : y + PATCH_SIZE, x : x + PATCH_SIZE]
                        if patch_label.sum() == 0 and np.random.rand() > 0.1:
                            continue
                    self.patches.append(
                        (
                            frag,
                            y,
                            x,
                            volume[y : y + PATCH_SIZE, x : x + PATCH_SIZE],
                            (
                                label[y : y + PATCH_SIZE, x : x + PATCH_SIZE]
                                if is_train
                                else None
                            ),
                        )
                    )

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.patches)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        frag, y, x, vol, label = self.patches[idx]
        vol = torch.tensor(vol, dtype=torch.float32).permute(2, 0, 1)
        if self.is_train:
            label = torch.tensor(label, dtype=torch.float32).unsqueeze(0)
            return vol, label
        return vol


class UNet(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()

        def conv_block(in_ch, out_ch):
            return nn.Sequential(
                nn.Conv2d(in_ch, out_ch, 3, padding=1),
                nn.ReLU(inplace=True),
                nn.Conv2d(out_ch, out_ch, 3, padding=1),
                nn.ReLU(inplace=True),

        self.enc1 = conv_block(NUM_SLICES, 64)

        self.pool2 = nn.MaxPool2d(2)
        self.center = conv_block(128, 256)
        self.up2 = nn.ConvTranspose2d(256, 128, 2, stride=2)
        self.dec2 = conv_block(256, 128)
        self.up1 = nn.ConvTranspose2d(128, 64, 2, stride=2)
        self.dec1 = conv_block(128, 64)
        self.final = nn.Conv2d(64, 1, 1)

    def forward(self, x):
        enc1 = self.enc1(x)
        enc2 = self.enc2(self.pool1(enc1))
        center = self.center(self.pool2(enc2))
        dec2 = self.up2(center)
        dec2 = torch.cat([dec2, enc2], 1)
        dec2 = self.dec2(dec2)
        dec1 = self.up1(dec2)
        dec1 = torch.cat([dec1, enc1], 1)
        dec1 = self.dec1(dec1)
        return self.final(dec1)

            std = np.std(selected_slices, axis=0).astype(np.float32)

            # Independent channel normalization

BATCH_SIZE = 32

OVERLAP = 128

class ScrollDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, fragments, is_train=True):
        self.is_train = is_train
        self.patches = []

        for frag in fragments:
            mask = np.array(Image.open(f"input/train/{frag}/mask.png"))
            if is_train:
                label = np.array(Image.open(f"input/train/{frag}/inklabels.png"))

            slices = [
                imread(f"input/train/{frag}/surface_volume/{i:02}.tif")
                for i in range(SLICE_START, SLICE_START + NUM_SLICES)
            ]
            volume = np.stack(slices, axis=2)

            h, w = volume.shape[:2]
            for y in range(0, h, PATCH_SIZE // 2):
                for x in range(0, w, PATCH_SIZE // 2):
                    y_end = min(y + PATCH_SIZE, h)
                    x_end = min(x + PATCH_SIZE, w)

                    # Extract and pad patch
                    vol_patch = volume[y:y_end, x:x_end]
                    pad_y = PATCH_SIZE - (y_end - y)
                    pad_x = PATCH_SIZE - (x_end - x)

                    if pad_y > 0 or pad_x > 0:
                        vol_patch = np.pad(
                            vol_patch, ((0, pad_y), (0, pad_x), (0, 0)), mode="reflect"
                        )

                    if is_train:
                        label_patch = label[y:y_end, x:x_end]
                        if pad_y > 0 or pad_x > 0:
                            label_patch = np.pad(
                                label_patch,
                                ((0, pad_y), (0, pad_x)),
                                mode="constant",
                                constant_values=0,
                            )
                        if label_patch.sum() == 0 and np.random.rand() > 0.1:
                            continue

                    self.patches.append(
                        (
                            torch.tensor(vol_patch, dtype=torch.float32).permute(
                                2, 0, 1
                            ),
                            (
                                torch.tensor(
                                    label_patch, dtype=torch.float32
                                ).unsqueeze(0)
                                if is_train
                                else None
                            ),
                        )
                    )

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.patches)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        if self.is_train:
            return self.patches[idx]
        return self.patches[idx][0]


class SimpleUNet(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.encoder = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(NUM_SLICES, 32, 3, padding=1),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.MaxPool2d(2),
            nn.Conv2d(32, 64, 3, padding=1),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.MaxPool2d(2),
        )
        self.decoder = nn.Sequential(
            nn.ConvTranspose2d(64, 32, 2, stride=2),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.ConvTranspose2d(32, 16, 2, stride=2),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(16, 1, 1),
        )

    def forward(self, x):
        x = self.encoder(x)
        return self.decoder(x)

    pred = np.zeros((h, w), dtype=np.float32)
    count = np.zeros((h, w), dtype=np.float32)

    for y in range(0, h, OVERLAP):
        for x in range(0, w, OVERLAP):
            y_end = min(y + PATCH_SIZE, h)
            x_end = min(x + PATCH_SIZE, w)
            patch = volume[y:y_end, x:x_end]

            pad_y = PATCH_SIZE - (y_end - y)
            pad_x = PATCH_SIZE - (x_end - x)
            if pad_y > 0 or pad_x > 0:
                patch = np.pad(patch, ((0, pad_y), (0, pad_x), (0, 0)), mode="reflect")

            patch_t = (
                torch.tensor(patch, dtype=torch.float32)
                .permute(2, 0, 1)
                .unsqueeze(0)
                .to(DEVICE)
            )
            with torch.no_grad():
                p = torch.sigmoid(model(patch_t))[0, 0].cpu().numpy()

            valid_h = y_end - y
            valid_w = x_end - x
            pred[y:y_end, x:x_end] += p[:valid_h, :valid_w]
            count[y:y_end, x:x_end] += 1

    pred = pred / count
    mask = np.array(Image.open(f"input/test/{fragment_id}/mask.png")) / 255.0
    return pred * mask

    return " ".join(map(str, runs))

                x = torch.tensor(patch).permute(2, 0, 1).float().unsqueeze(0).to(device)
                p = torch.sigmoid(model(x)).squeeze().cpu().numpy()

                if tta in [1, 3]:
                    p = np.flipud(p)
                if tta in [2, 3]:
                    p = np.fliplr(p)
                pred[i : i + patch_size, j : j + patch_size] += p

        pred = (pred / 4) > 0.5
        pred = pred[: ds.mip_pad.shape[0] - ds.pad_h, : ds.mip_pad.shape[1] - ds.pad_w]
        pred = pred & ds.mask_pad[: pred.shape[0], : pred.shape[1]]

import os
import glob
import cv2
import tifffile
import numpy as np
import torch
import torch.nn as nn
from torch.utils.data import Dataset, DataLoader
import pandas as pd
import albumentations as A
from albumentations.pytorch import ToTensorV2
import segmentation_models_pytorch as smp

# Config
patch_size = 256
batch_size = 16
epochs = 10
lr = 1e-4
device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
tversky_alpha = 0.7
tversky_beta = 0.3


class PapyrusDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, frag_dirs, transform=None):
        self.data = []
        self.transform = transform
        self.pad_h = 0
        self.pad_w = 0

        for dir in frag_dirs:
            slices = [
                tifffile.imread(p)
                for p in sorted(glob.glob(f"{dir}/surface_volume/*.tif"))
            ]
            selected_slices = slices[27:38]

            mean = np.mean(selected_slices, axis=0).astype(np.float32)
            max_ = np.max(selected_slices, axis=0).astype(np.float32)
            std = np.std(selected_slices, axis=0).astype(np.float32)

            mean = (mean - mean.mean()) / mean.std()
            max_ = (max_ - max_.mean()) / max_.std()
            std = (std - std.mean()) / std.std()

            mip = np.stack([mean, max_, std], axis=-1)

            mask = cv2.imread(f"{dir}/mask.png", 0) > 0
            if "train" in dir:
                ink = cv2.imread(f"{dir}/inklabels.png", 0) > 0
                target = (ink & mask).astype(np.float32)
            else:
                target = np.zeros_like(mask, dtype=np.float32)

            H, W = mip.shape[:2]
            pad_h = (patch_size - H % patch_size) % patch_size
            pad_w = (patch_size - W % patch_size) % patch_size

            self.mip_pad = np.pad(
                mip, ((0, pad_h), (0, pad_w), (0, 0)), mode="constant"
            )
            self.target_pad = np.pad(target, ((0, pad_h), (0, pad_w)), mode="constant")
            self.mask_pad = np.pad(mask, ((0, pad_h), (0, pad_w)), mode="constant")

            self.coords = []
            for i in range(0, self.mip_pad.shape[0], patch_size):
                for j in range(0, self.mip_pad.shape[1], patch_size):
                    if self.mask_pad[i : i + patch_size, j : j + patch_size].any():
                        self.coords.append((i, j))

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.coords)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        i, j = self.coords[idx]
        img = self.mip_pad[i : i + patch_size, j : j + patch_size]
        target = self.target_pad[i : i + patch_size, j : j + patch_size]
        mask = self.mask_pad[i : i + patch_size, j : j + patch_size]

        if self.transform:
            aug = self.transform(image=img, mask=target)
            return (
                aug["image"].float(),
                aug["mask"].float(),
                torch.tensor(mask).bool(),
            )
        else:
            return (
                torch.tensor(img).permute(2, 0, 1).float(),
                torch.tensor(target).float(),
                torch.tensor(mask).bool(),
            )


train_aug = A.Compose(
    [
        A.HorizontalFlip(p=0.5),
        A.VerticalFlip(p=0.5),
        A.RandomRotate90(p=0.5),
        A.RandomBrightnessContrast(p=0.3),
        ToTensorV2(),
    ]
)

model = smp.Unet("resnet50", in_channels=3, classes=1, encoder_weights="imagenet").to(
    device
)
opt = torch.optim.AdamW(model.parameters(), lr=lr)
criterion_bce = nn.BCEWithLogitsLoss()

train_ds = PapyrusDataset(["input/train/1"], train_aug)
val_ds = PapyrusDataset(["input/train/2"])
train_loader = DataLoader(train_ds, batch_size=batch_size, shuffle=True, num_workers=4)
val_loader = DataLoader(val_ds, batch_size=batch_size, num_workers=4)

best_f05 = 0
for epoch in range(epochs):
    model.train()
    for x, y, m in train_loader:
        x, y, m = x.to(device), y.to(device), m.to(device)
        opt.zero_grad()
        pred = model(x).squeeze(1)

        # BCE loss
        bce_loss = criterion_bce(pred[m], y[m])

        # Tversky loss with precision focus
        probs = torch.sigmoid(pred)
        y_masked = y[m]
        probs_masked = probs[m]

        tp = (probs_masked * y_masked).sum()
        fp = (probs_masked * (1 - y_masked)).sum()
        fn = ((1 - probs_masked) * y_masked).sum()

        tversky_loss = 1 - (tp + 1e-5) / (
            tp + tversky_alpha * fp + tversky_beta * fn + 1e-5
        )

        total_loss = bce_loss + tversky_loss
        total_loss.backward()
        opt.step()

    model.eval()
    tp, fp, fn = 0, 0, 0
    with torch.no_grad():
        for x, y, m in val_loader:
            x, y, m = x.to(device), y.to(device), m.to(device)
            pred = torch.sigmoid(model(x).squeeze(1))
            y_pred = (pred > 0.5)[m]
            y_true = y[m].bool()
            tp += (y_pred & y_true).sum().item()
            fp += (y_pred & ~y_true).sum().item()
            fn += (~y_pred & y_true).sum().item()

    precision = tp / (tp + fp + 1e-6)
    recall = tp / (tp + fn + 1e-6)
    f05 = (1.25 * precision * recall) / (0.25 * precision + recall + 1e-6)
    print(f"Epoch {epoch+1}: F0.5={f05:.4f}")
    if f05 > best_f05:
        best_f05 = f05
        torch.save(model.state_dict(), "best_model.pth")

model.load_state_dict(torch.load("best_model.pth"))

    runs = np.where(pixels[1:] != pixels[:-1])[0] + 1
    runs[1::2] -= runs[::2]
    return " ".join(map(str, runs))

import os
import numpy as np
import tifffile
import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F
from torch.utils.data import Dataset, DataLoader
from torchvision.models.segmentation import deeplabv3_resnet50
from tqdm import tqdm
import pandas as pd
import cv2


def rle_encode(img):
    pixels = img.T.flatten()
    pixels = np.concatenate([[0], pixels, [0]])
    runs = np.where(pixels[1:] != pixels[:-1])[0] + 1
    runs[1::2] -= runs[::2]
    return " ".join(map(str, runs))


class InkDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, fragment_ids, z_slices=range(20, 40), is_train=True):
        self.z_slices = z_slices
        self.data = []
        self.masks = []
        self.labels = []
        for frag_id in fragment_ids:
            path = os.path.join("input", "train" if is_train else "test", str(frag_id))
            slices = [
                tifffile.imread(os.path.join(path, "surface_volume", f"{i:02}.tif"))
                for i in self.z_slices
            ]
            self.data.append(np.stack(slices, axis=2))
            if is_train:
                mask = (
                    cv2.imread(os.path.join(path, "mask.png"), cv2.IMREAD_GRAYSCALE)
                    / 255
                )
                self.masks.append(mask)
                label = (
                    cv2.imread(
                        os.path.join(path, "inklabels.png"), cv2.IMREAD_GRAYSCALE
                    )
                    / 255
                )
                self.labels.append(label)

    def __len__(self):
        return 2000  # Fixed samples per epoch

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        frag_idx = np.random.randint(len(self.data))
        img = self.data[frag_idx].copy()
        mask = self.masks[frag_idx].copy()
        label = self.labels[frag_idx].copy()
        h, w, _ = img.shape
        i, j = np.random.randint(0, h - 256), np.random.randint(0, w - 256)
        img = img[i : i + 256, j : j + 256]
        mask = mask[i : i + 256, j : j + 256]
        label = label[i : i + 256, j : j + 256]
        if np.random.rand() > 0.5:
            img, mask, label = [np.flip(x, 1).copy() for x in [img, mask, label]]
        if np.random.rand() > 0.5:
            img, mask, label = [np.flip(x, 0).copy() for x in [img, mask, label]]
        if np.random.rand() > 0.5:
            img, mask, label = [np.rot90(x).copy() for x in [img, mask, label]]
        img = torch.tensor(img).permute(2, 0, 1).float()
        label = torch.tensor(label).float().unsqueeze(0) * mask
        return img, label


class FocalLoss(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, alpha=0.8, gamma=2.0):
        super().__init__()
        self.alpha = alpha
        self.gamma = gamma

    def forward(self, inputs, targets):
        bce_loss = F.binary_cross_entropy_with_logits(inputs, targets, reduction="none")
        pt = torch.exp(-bce_loss)
        focal_loss = self.alpha * (1 - pt) ** self.gamma * bce_loss
        return focal_loss.mean()


def dice_loss(pred_logits, target):
    pred = torch.sigmoid(pred_logits)
    smooth = 1e-5
    intersection = (pred * target).sum()
    union = pred.sum() + target.sum()
    return 1 - (2.0 * intersection + smooth) / (union + smooth)


def f05_score(true, pred):
    tp = np.sum((true == 1) & (pred == 1))
    fp = np.sum((true == 0) & (pred == 1))
    fn = np.sum((true == 1) & (pred == 0))
    precision = tp / (tp + fp + 1e-6)
    recall = tp / (tp + fn + 1e-6)
    return (1.25 * precision * recall) / (0.25 * precision + recall + 1e-6)


def apply_tta(model, patch):
    preds = []
    # Original
    pred = torch.sigmoid(model(patch)["out"])
    preds.append(pred)
    # Flip horizontal
    pred_h = torch.sigmoid(model(torch.flip(patch, dims=[3]))["out"])
    pred_h = torch.flip(pred_h, dims=[3])
    preds.append(pred_h)
    # Flip vertical
    pred_v = torch.sigmoid(model(torch.flip(patch, dims=[2]))["out"])
    pred_v = torch.flip(pred_v, dims=[2])
    preds.append(pred_v)
    # Flip both
    pred_both = torch.sigmoid(model(torch.flip(patch, dims=[2, 3]))["out"])
    pred_both = torch.flip(pred_both, dims=[2, 3])
    preds.append(pred_both)
    return torch.mean(torch.stack(preds), dim=0)


# Model setup
model = deeplabv3_resnet50(pretrained=False)
model.backbone.conv1 = nn.Conv2d(20, 64, kernel_size=7, stride=2, padding=3, bias=False)
model.classifier[4] = nn.Conv2d(256, 1, kernel_size=1)
device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
model.to(device)

# Training config
optimizer = torch.optim.AdamW(model.parameters(), lr=1e-4)
criterion = FocalLoss(alpha=0.8, gamma=2.0).to(device)
train_ds = InkDataset([1, 2])
train_loader = DataLoader(
    train_ds, batch_size=8, shuffle=True, num_workers=4, pin_memory=True
)

# Validation setup
val_ds = InkDataset([2], is_train=True)
val_img = val_ds.data[0].transpose(2, 0, 1)[np.newaxis, ...]
val_mask = val_ds.masks[0]
val_label = val_ds.labels[0]

# Training loop
best_score = 0
for epoch in range(5):
    model.train()
    pbar = tqdm(train_loader, desc=f"Epoch {epoch+1}")
    for x, y in pbar:
        x, y = x.to(device), y.to(device)
        optimizer.zero_grad()
        out = model(x)["out"]
        loss = criterion(out, y) + dice_loss(out, y)
        loss.backward()
        optimizer.step()
        pbar.set_postfix(loss=loss.item())

# Threshold optimization
model.load_state_dict(torch.load("best_model.pth"))
model.eval()
best_thresh = 0.4
best_score = 0
with torch.no_grad():
    pred = torch.zeros_like(torch.tensor(val_label)).float()
    for i in range(0, val_img.shape[2], 224):
        for j in range(0, val_img.shape[3], 224):
            patch = val_img[:, :, i : i + 256, j : j + 256]
            if patch.shape[2] < 256 or patch.shape[3] < 256:
                continue
            x_patch = torch.tensor(patch).float().to(device)
            out = apply_tta(model, x_patch).cpu().squeeze()
            pred[i : i + 256, j : j + 256] = torch.maximum(
                pred[i : i + 256, j : j + 256], out
            )

    # Find optimal threshold
    for thresh in np.arange(0.1, 0.7, 0.05):
        current_pred = (pred > thresh).numpy().astype(int)
        score = f05_score(val_label, current_pred * val_mask)
        if score > best_score:
            best_score = score
            best_thresh = thresh
    print(f"Best threshold: {best_thresh:.2f}, Val F0.5: {best_score:.4f}")

# Generate submission
model.eval()
sub = []
test_fragments = [
    f for f in os.listdir("input/test") if os.path.isdir(os.path.join("input/test", f))
]

with torch.no_grad():
    for frag_id in test_fragments:
        test_path = os.path.join("input/test", frag_id)
        mask = (
            cv2.imread(os.path.join(test_path, "mask.png"), cv2.IMREAD_GRAYSCALE) / 255
        )
        slices = [
            tifffile.imread(os.path.join(test_path, "surface_volume", f"{i:02}.tif"))
            for i in range(20, 40)
        ]
        vol = np.stack(slices, axis=2).transpose(2, 0, 1)[np.newaxis, ...]

        pred = np.zeros(mask.shape)
        for i in range(0, vol.shape[2], 128):
            for j in range(0, vol.shape[3], 128):
                patch = vol[:, :, i : i + 256, j : j + 256]
                if patch.shape[2] < 256 or patch.shape[3] < 256:
                    continue
                x = torch.tensor(patch).float().to(device)
                out = apply_tta(model, x).cpu().squeeze().numpy()
                pred[i : i + 256, j : j + 256] = np.maximum(
                    pred[i : i + 256, j : j + 256], out
                )

        pred = (pred > best_thresh).astype(np.uint8) * mask.astype(np.uint8)
        sub.append({"Id": frag_id, "Predicted": rle_encode(pred)})

pd.DataFrame(sub).to_csv("submission/submission.csv", index=False)

class InkDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, fragment_dirs, patch_size, transform=None):
        self.patches = []
        self.transform = transform

        for frag_dir in fragment_dirs:
            image = load_volume(frag_dir)
            mask = cv2.imread(
                os.path.join(frag_dir, "inklabels.png"), cv2.IMREAD_GRAYSCALE
            )
            frag_mask = cv2.imread(
                os.path.join(frag_dir, "mask.png"), cv2.IMREAD_GRAYSCALE
            )
            mask = ((mask > 0) & (frag_mask > 0)).astype(np.float32)

            H, W = image.shape[:2]
            for y in range(0, H, patch_size):
                for x in range(0, W, patch_size):
                    if y + patch_size > H or x + patch_size > W:
                        continue
                    self.patches.append(
                        (
                            image[y : y + patch_size, x : x + patch_size],
                            mask[y : y + patch_size, x : x + patch_size],
                        )
                    )

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.patches)

        img, mask = self.patches[idx]
        if self.transform:

import os
import glob
import cv2
import tifffile
import numpy as np
import torch
import torch.nn as nn
from torch.utils.data import Dataset, DataLoader
import pandas as pd
import albumentations as A
from albumentations.pytorch import ToTensorV2
import segmentation_models_pytorch as smp
from torchvision.models import resnet50

# Config
patch_size = 256
batch_size = 16
epochs = 10
lr = 1e-4
device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
tversky_alpha = 0.7
tversky_beta = 0.3


class PapyrusDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, frag_dirs, transform=None):
        self.data = []
        self.transform = transform
        self.pad_h = 0
        self.pad_w = 0

        for dir in frag_dirs:
            slices = [
                tifffile.imread(p)
                for p in sorted(glob.glob(f"{dir}/surface_volume/*.tif"))
            ]
            selected_slices = slices[25:40]  # Expanded slice range

            # Compute gradient features
            grad_mags = []
            for s in selected_slices:
                dx = cv2.Sobel(s, cv2.CV_64F, 1, 0, ksize=3)
                dy = cv2.Sobel(s, cv2.CV_64F, 0, 1, ksize=3)
                grad_mags.append(np.sqrt(dx**2 + dy**2))

            mean_grad = np.mean(grad_mags, axis=0).astype(np.float32)
            mean = np.mean(selected_slices, axis=0).astype(np.float32)
            max_ = np.max(selected_slices, axis=0).astype(np.float32)
            std = np.std(selected_slices, axis=0).astype(np.float32)

            # Normalize features
            for arr in [mean, max_, std, mean_grad]:
                arr -= arr.mean()
                arr /= arr.std()

            mip = np.stack([mean, max_, std, mean_grad], axis=-1)

            mask = cv2.imread(f"{dir}/mask.png", 0) > 0
            if "train" in dir:
                ink = cv2.imread(f"{dir}/inklabels.png", 0) > 0
                target = (ink & mask).astype(np.float32)
            else:
                target = np.zeros_like(mask, dtype=np.float32)

            H, W = mip.shape[:2]
            pad_h = (patch_size - H % patch_size) % patch_size
            pad_w = (patch_size - W % patch_size) % patch_size

            self.mip_pad = np.pad(
                mip, ((0, pad_h), (0, pad_w), (0, 0)), mode="constant"
            )
            self.target_pad = np.pad(target, ((0, pad_h), (0, pad_w)), mode="constant")
            self.mask_pad = np.pad(mask, ((0, pad_h), (0, pad_w)), mode="constant")
            self.coords = [
                (i, j)
                for i in range(0, self.mip_pad.shape[0], patch_size)
                for j in range(0, self.mip_pad.shape[1], patch_size)
                if self.mask_pad[i : i + patch_size, j : j + patch_size].any()
            ]

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.coords)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        i, j = self.coords[idx]
        img = self.mip_pad[i : i + patch_size, j : j + patch_size]
        target = self.target_pad[i : i + patch_size, j : j + patch_size]
        mask = self.mask_pad[i : i + patch_size, j : j + patch_size]

        if self.transform:
            aug = self.transform(image=img, mask=target)
            return aug["image"].float(), aug["mask"].float(), torch.tensor(mask).bool()
        return (
            torch.tensor(img).permute(2, 0, 1).float(),
            torch.tensor(target).float(),
            torch.tensor(mask).bool(),
        )


# Modified model initialization with 4 input channels
model = smp.Unet("resnet50", in_channels=4, classes=1, encoder_weights=None)
pretrained = resnet50(pretrained=True).state_dict()
pretrained["conv1.weight"] = torch.cat(
    [pretrained["conv1.weight"], pretrained["conv1.weight"].mean(1, keepdim=True)], 1
)
model.encoder.load_state_dict(pretrained, strict=False)
model = model.to(device)

train_aug = A.Compose(
    [
        A.HorizontalFlip(p=0.5),
        A.VerticalFlip(p=0.5),
        A.RandomRotate90(p=0.5),
        A.GridDistortion(p=0.3),
        ToTensorV2(),
    ]
)

opt = torch.optim.AdamW(model.parameters(), lr=lr, weight_decay=1e-4)
scheduler = torch.optim.lr_scheduler.ReduceLROnPlateau(
    opt, "max", patience=2, factor=0.5
)
criterion_bce = nn.BCEWithLogitsLoss()

train_ds = PapyrusDataset(["input/train/1"], train_aug)
val_ds = PapyrusDataset(["input/train/2"])
train_loader = DataLoader(
    train_ds, batch_size=batch_size, shuffle=True, num_workers=4, pin_memory=True
)
val_loader = DataLoader(val_ds, batch_size=batch_size, num_workers=4, pin_memory=True)

best_f05 = 0
for epoch in range(epochs):
    model.train()
    for x, y, m in train_loader:
        x, y, m = x.to(device), y.to(device), m.to(device)
        opt.zero_grad()
        pred = model(x).squeeze(1)

        # Combined loss
        bce_loss = criterion_bce(pred[m], y[m])
        probs = torch.sigmoid(pred)
        tp = (probs[m] * y[m]).sum()
        fp = (probs[m] * (1 - y[m])).sum()
        fn = ((1 - probs[m]) * y[m]).sum()
        tversky_loss = 1 - (tp + 1e-5) / (
            tp + tversky_alpha * fp + tversky_beta * fn + 1e-5
        )
        (bce_loss + tversky_loss).backward()
        opt.step()

    model.eval()
    tp = fp = fn = 0
    with torch.no_grad():
        for x, y, m in val_loader:
            x, y, m = x.to(device), y.to(device), m.to(device)
            pred = torch.sigmoid(model(x).squeeze(1))
            y_pred = (pred > 0.4)[m]  # Adjusted threshold
            y_true = y[m].bool()
            tp += (y_pred & y_true).sum().item()
            fp += (y_pred & ~y_true).sum().item()
            fn += (~y_pred & y_true).sum().item()

    precision = tp / (tp + fp + 1e-6)
    recall = tp / (tp + fn + 1e-6)
    f05 = (1.25 * precision * recall) / (0.25 * precision + recall + 1e-6)
    scheduler.step(f05)
    print(f"Epoch {epoch+1}: F0.5={f05:.4f}")
    if f05 > best_f05:
        best_f05 = f05
        torch.save(model.state_dict(), "best_model.pth")

model.load_state_dict(torch.load("best_model.pth"))


def rle_encode(mask):
    pixels = mask.flatten()
    pixels = np.concatenate([[0], pixels, [0]])
    runs = np.where(pixels[1:] != pixels[:-1])[0] + 1
    runs[1::2] -= runs[::2]
    return " ".join(map(str, runs))

                pred[i : i + patch_size, j : j + patch_size] += p

        pred = (pred / 4) > 0.4  # Consistent threshold
        pred = pred[: ds.mip_pad.shape[0] - ds.pad_h, : ds.mip_pad.shape[1] - ds.pad_w]
        pred &= ds.mask_pad[: pred.shape[0], : pred.shape[1]]

def rle_encode(img):
    pixels = img.T.flatten()
    pixels = np.concatenate([[0], pixels, [0]])
    runs = np.where(pixels[1:] != pixels[:-1])[0] + 1
    runs[1::2] -= runs[::2]
    return " ".join(map(str, runs))


class InkDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, fragment_ids, z_slices=range(20, 40), is_train=True):
        self.z_slices = z_slices
        self.data = []
        self.masks = []
        self.labels = []
        for frag_id in fragment_ids:
            path = os.path.join("input", "train" if is_train else "test", str(frag_id))
            slices = [
                tifffile.imread(os.path.join(path, "surface_volume", f"{i:02}.tif"))
                for i in self.z_slices
            ]
            self.data.append(np.stack(slices, axis=2))
            if is_train:
                mask = (
                    cv2.imread(os.path.join(path, "mask.png"), cv2.IMREAD_GRAYSCALE)
                    / 255
                )
                self.masks.append(mask)
                label = (
                    cv2.imread(
                        os.path.join(path, "inklabels.png"), cv2.IMREAD_GRAYSCALE
                    )
                    / 255
                )
                self.labels.append(label)

    def __len__(self):
        return 2000

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        frag_idx = np.random.randint(len(self.data))
        img = self.data[frag_idx].copy()
        mask = self.masks[frag_idx].copy()
        label = self.labels[frag_idx].copy()
        h, w, _ = img.shape
        i, j = np.random.randint(0, h - 256), np.random.randint(0, w - 256)
        img = img[i : i + 256, j : j + 256]
        mask = mask[i : i + 256, j : j + 256]
        label = label[i : i + 256, j : j + 256]
        if np.random.rand() > 0.5:
            img, mask, label = [np.flip(x, 1).copy() for x in [img, mask, label]]
        if np.random.rand() > 0.5:
            img, mask, label = [np.flip(x, 0).copy() for x in [img, mask, label]]
        if np.random.rand() > 0.5:
            img, mask, label = [np.rot90(x).copy() for x in [img, mask, label]]
        img = torch.tensor(img).permute(2, 0, 1).float()
        label = torch.tensor(label).float().unsqueeze(0) * mask
        return img, label


class FocalLoss(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, alpha=0.8, gamma=2.0):
        super().__init__()
        self.alpha = alpha
        self.gamma = gamma

    def forward(self, inputs, targets):
        bce_loss = F.binary_cross_entropy_with_logits(inputs, targets, reduction="none")
        pt = torch.exp(-bce_loss)
        focal_loss = self.alpha * (1 - pt) ** self.gamma * bce_loss
        return focal_loss.mean()


def dice_loss(pred_logits, target):
    pred = torch.sigmoid(pred_logits)
    smooth = 1e-5
    intersection = (pred * target).sum()
    union = pred.sum() + target.sum()
    return 1 - (2.0 * intersection + smooth) / (union + smooth)


def f05_score(true, pred):
    tp = np.sum((true == 1) & (pred == 1))
    fp = np.sum((true == 0) & (pred == 1))
    fn = np.sum((true == 1) & (pred == 0))
    precision = tp / (tp + fp + 1e-6)
    recall = tp / (tp + fn + 1e-6)
    return (1.25 * precision * recall) / (0.25 * precision + recall + 1e-6)


def apply_tta(model, patch):
    preds = []
    pred = torch.sigmoid(model(patch)["out"])
    preds.append(pred)
    pred_h = torch.sigmoid(model(torch.flip(patch, dims=[3]))["out"])
    pred_h = torch.flip(pred_h, dims=[3])
    preds.append(pred_h)
    pred_v = torch.sigmoid(model(torch.flip(patch, dims=[2]))["out"])
    pred_v = torch.flip(pred_v, dims=[2])
    preds.append(pred_v)
    pred_both = torch.sigmoid(model(torch.flip(patch, dims=[2, 3]))["out"])
    pred_both = torch.flip(pred_both, dims=[2, 3])
    preds.append(pred_both)
    return torch.mean(torch.stack(preds), dim=0)


model = deeplabv3_resnet50(pretrained=False)
model.backbone.conv1 = nn.Conv2d(20, 64, kernel_size=7, stride=2, padding=3, bias=False)
model.classifier[4] = nn.Conv2d(256, 1, kernel_size=1)
device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
model.to(device)

optimizer = torch.optim.AdamW(model.parameters(), lr=1e-4)
criterion = FocalLoss(alpha=0.8, gamma=2.0).to(device)
train_ds = InkDataset([1])
val_ds = InkDataset([2])
train_loader = DataLoader(
    train_ds, batch_size=8, shuffle=True, num_workers=4, pin_memory=True
)

best_score = 0
for epoch in range(5):
    model.train()
    pbar = tqdm(train_loader, desc=f"Epoch {epoch+1}")
    for x, y in pbar:
        x, y = x.to(device), y.to(device)
        optimizer.zero_grad()
        out = model(x)["out"]
        loss = criterion(out, y) + dice_loss(out, y)
        loss.backward()
        optimizer.step()
        pbar.set_postfix(loss=loss.item())

    # Validation
    model.eval()
    val_img = val_ds.data[0].transpose(2, 0, 1)[np.newaxis, ...]
    val_mask = val_ds.masks[0]
    val_label = val_ds.labels[0]
    pred = np.zeros_like(val_label)
    with torch.no_grad():
        for i in range(0, val_img.shape[2], 128):
            for j in range(0, val_img.shape[3], 128):
                patch = val_img[:, :, i : i + 256, j : j + 256]
                if patch.shape[2] < 256 or patch.shape[3] < 256:
                    continue
                x_patch = torch.tensor(patch).float().to(device)
                out = apply_tta(model, x_patch).cpu().squeeze().numpy()
                pred[i : i + 256, j : j + 256] = np.maximum(
                    pred[i : i + 256, j : j + 256], out
                )

    score = f05_score(val_label, (pred > 0.4).astype(int) * val_mask.astype(int))
    if score > best_score:

DEVICE = "cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu"

LR = 1e-4
SLICES = [25, 27, 29, 31, 33, 35]  # 6 slices for richer depth information


def load_volume(fragment_dir):
    slices = []
    for i in SLICES:
        slice_path = os.path.join(fragment_dir, "surface_volume", f"{i:02d}.tif")
        slices.append(tifffile.imread(slice_path))
    return np.stack(slices, axis=-1).astype(np.float32)


# Compute dataset statistics for proper normalization
train_dirs = [os.path.join("input/train", d) for d in os.listdir("input/train")]
all_patches = []
for frag_dir in train_dirs[:2]:  # Use first 2 fragments for faster computation
    image = load_volume(frag_dir)
    H, W = image.shape[:2]
    for y in range(0, H, PATCH_SIZE):
        for x in range(0, W, PATCH_SIZE):
            if y + PATCH_SIZE > H or x + PATCH_SIZE > W:
                continue
            patch = image[y : y + PATCH_SIZE, x : x + PATCH_SIZE]
            all_patches.append(patch)

all_patches = np.array(all_patches)
mean = np.mean(all_patches, axis=(0, 1, 2))
std = np.std(all_patches, axis=(0, 1, 2))


class InkDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, fragment_dirs, patch_size, transform=None):
        self.patches = []
        self.transform = transform

        for frag_dir in fragment_dirs:
            image = load_volume(frag_dir)
            mask = cv2.imread(
                os.path.join(frag_dir, "inklabels.png"), cv2.IMREAD_GRAYSCALE
            )
            frag_mask = cv2.imread(
                os.path.join(frag_dir, "mask.png"), cv2.IMREAD_GRAYSCALE
            )
            mask = ((mask > 0) & (frag_mask > 0)).astype(np.float32)

            H, W = image.shape[:2]
            for y in range(0, H, patch_size):
                for x in range(0, W, patch_size):
                    if y + patch_size > H or x + patch_size > W:
                        continue
                    self.patches.append(
                        (
                            image[y : y + patch_size, x : x + patch_size],
                            mask[y : y + patch_size, x : x + patch_size],
                        )
                    )

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.patches)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        img, mask = self.patches[idx]
        if self.transform:
            aug = self.transform(image=img, mask=mask)
            img, mask = aug["image"], aug["mask"]
        return img, mask


model = smp.Unet(
    encoder_name="efficientnet-b4",
    encoder_weights="imagenet",

).to(DEVICE)

    mode="binary", alpha=0.5, beta=2.0, from_logits=True
)  # Adjusted parameters


def criterion(pred, target):
    return 0.4 * bce_loss(pred, target) + 0.6 * tversky_loss(pred, target)


optimizer = Adam(model.parameters(), lr=LR, weight_decay=1e-5)

train_transform = A.Compose(
    [
        A.Normalize(mean=mean.tolist(), std=std.tolist()),

)

best_score = 0
for epoch in range(EPOCHS):
    model.train()
    for X, y in train_loader:
        X, y = X.to(DEVICE), y.to(DEVICE)
        optimizer.zero_grad()
        pred = model(X.permute(0, 3, 1, 2))
        loss = criterion(pred, y.unsqueeze(1))
        loss.backward()
        optimizer.step()

    model.eval()
    tp, fp, fn = 0, 0, 0
    with torch.no_grad():
        for X, y in val_loader:
            X, y = X.to(DEVICE), y.to(DEVICE)
            pred = torch.sigmoid(model(X.permute(0, 3, 1, 2)))
            pred_bin = (pred > 0.35).float()
            tp += (pred_bin * y.unsqueeze(1)).sum().item()
            fp += (pred_bin * (1 - y.unsqueeze(1))).sum().item()
            fn += ((1 - pred_bin) * y.unsqueeze(1)).sum().item()

    precision = tp / (tp + fp + 1e-6)
    recall = tp / (tp + fn + 1e-6)
    f05 = (1.25 * precision * recall) / (0.25 * precision + recall + 1e-6)
    print(f"Epoch {epoch+1}: F0.5={f05:.4f}")

                dy = cv2.Sobel(s, cv2.CV_64F, 0, 1, ksize=3)
                grad_mags.append(np.sqrt(dx**2 + dy**2))

            features = [
                np.mean(selected_slices, axis=0).astype(np.float32),
                np.max(selected_slices, axis=0).astype(np.float32),
                np.std(selected_slices, axis=0).astype(np.float32),
                np.mean(grad_mags, axis=0).astype(np.float32),
            ]

            for arr in features:
                arr -= arr.mean()
                arr /= arr.std()

            self.mip = np.stack(features, axis=-1)
            self.mask = cv2.imread(f"{dir}/mask.png", 0) > 0
            self.target = (

            self.mask_pad = np.pad(self.mask, ((0, self.pad_h), (0, self.pad_w)))
            self.coords = [
                (i, j)
                for i in range(0, self.mip_pad.shape[0], patch_size)
                for j in range(0, self.mip_pad.shape[1], patch_size)
                if self.mask_pad[i : i + patch_size, j : j + patch_size].any()
            ]

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.coords)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        i, j = self.coords[idx]
        img = self.mip_pad[i : i + patch_size, j : j + patch_size]
        mask = self.mask_pad[i : i + patch_size, j : j + patch_size]
        target = (
            self.target[i : i + patch_size, j : j + patch_size]

        )

            )

            target = aug["mask"].float() if target is not None else None
        else:
            img = torch.tensor(img).permute(2, 0, 1).float()

        return (
            (img, target.float(), torch.tensor(mask).bool())
            if target is not None

        )

# Enhanced Config
SLICE_START = 27
NUM_SLICES = 11
PATCH_SIZE = 256
BATCH_SIZE = 32
EPOCHS = 5
THRESHOLD = 0.4
OVERLAP = 64  # Reduced overlap for deeper model
DEVICE = "cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu"


class ScrollDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, fragments, is_train=True):
        self.is_train = is_train
        self.patches = []
        for frag in fragments:
            mask = np.array(Image.open(f"input/train/{frag}/mask.png"))
            if is_train:
                label = np.array(Image.open(f"input/train/{frag}/inklabels.png"))

            slices = [
                imread(f"input/train/{frag}/surface_volume/{i:02}.tif")
                for i in range(SLICE_START, SLICE_START + NUM_SLICES)
            ]
            volume = np.stack(slices, axis=2)

            h, w = volume.shape[:2]
            for y in range(0, h, PATCH_SIZE // 2):
                for x in range(0, w, PATCH_SIZE // 2):
                    y_end = min(y + PATCH_SIZE, h)
                    x_end = min(x + PATCH_SIZE, w)
                    vol_patch = volume[y:y_end, x:x_end]
                    pad_y = PATCH_SIZE - (y_end - y)
                    pad_x = PATCH_SIZE - (x_end - x)

                    if pad_y > 0 or pad_x > 0:
                        vol_patch = np.pad(
                            vol_patch, ((0, pad_y), (0, pad_x), (0, 0)), mode="reflect"
                        )

                    if is_train:
                        label_patch = label[y:y_end, x:x_end]
                        if pad_y > 0 or pad_x > 0:
                            label_patch = np.pad(
                                label_patch,
                                ((0, pad_y), (0, pad_x)),
                                mode="constant",
                                constant_values=0,
                            )
                        if label_patch.sum() == 0 and np.random.rand() > 0.1:
                            continue

                    self.patches.append(
                        (
                            torch.tensor(vol_patch, dtype=torch.float32).permute(
                                2, 0, 1
                            ),
                            (
                                torch.tensor(
                                    label_patch, dtype=torch.float32
                                ).unsqueeze(0)
                                if is_train
                                else None
                            ),
                        )
                    )

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.patches)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        return self.patches[idx] if self.is_train else self.patches[idx][0]


class DeepUNet(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        # Encoder
        self.enc1 = self._block(NUM_SLICES, 64)
        self.pool1 = nn.MaxPool2d(2)
        self.enc2 = self._block(64, 128)
        self.pool2 = nn.MaxPool2d(2)
        self.enc3 = self._block(128, 256)
        self.pool3 = nn.MaxPool2d(2)
        self.enc4 = self._block(256, 512)
        self.pool4 = nn.MaxPool2d(2)

        # Bridge
        self.bridge = self._block(512, 1024)

        # Decoder
        self.up4 = nn.ConvTranspose2d(1024, 512, 2, stride=2)
        self.dec4 = self._block(1024, 512)
        self.up3 = nn.ConvTranspose2d(512, 256, 2, stride=2)
        self.dec3 = self._block(512, 256)
        self.up2 = nn.ConvTranspose2d(256, 128, 2, stride=2)
        self.dec2 = self._block(256, 128)
        self.up1 = nn.ConvTranspose2d(128, 64, 2, stride=2)
        self.dec1 = self._block(128, 64)

        self.final = nn.Conv2d(64, 1, 1)

    def _block(self, in_c, out_c):
        return nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(in_c, out_c, 3, padding=1),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(out_c),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(out_c, out_c, 3, padding=1),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(out_c),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.2),
        )

    def forward(self, x):
        # Encoder
        e1 = self.enc1(x)
        e2 = self.enc2(self.pool1(e1))
        e3 = self.enc3(self.pool2(e2))
        e4 = self.enc4(self.pool3(e3))

        # Bridge
        b = self.bridge(self.pool4(e4))

        # Decoder with skip connections
        d4 = self.up4(b)
        d4 = torch.cat([d4, e4], dim=1)
        d4 = self.dec4(d4)

        d3 = self.up3(d4)
        d3 = torch.cat([d3, e3], dim=1)
        d3 = self.dec3(d3)

        d2 = self.up2(d3)
        d2 = torch.cat([d2, e2], dim=1)
        d2 = self.dec2(d2)

        d1 = self.up1(d2)
        d1 = torch.cat([d1, e1], dim=1)
        d1 = self.dec1(d1)

        return self.final(d1)


def predict_fragment(model, fragment_id):
    model.eval()
    slices = [
        imread(f"input/test/{fragment_id}/surface_volume/{i:02}.tif")
        for i in range(SLICE_START, SLICE_START + NUM_SLICES)
    ]
    volume = np.stack(slices, axis=2)
    h, w = volume.shape[:2]
    pred = np.zeros((h, w), dtype=np.float32)
    count = np.zeros((h, w), dtype=np.float32)

    for y in range(0, h, OVERLAP):
        for x in range(0, w, OVERLAP):
            y_end = min(y + PATCH_SIZE, h)
            x_end = min(x + PATCH_SIZE, w)
            patch = volume[y:y_end, x:x_end]

            pad_y = PATCH_SIZE - (y_end - y)
            pad_x = PATCH_SIZE - (x_end - x)
            if pad_y > 0 or pad_x > 0:
                patch = np.pad(patch, ((0, pad_y), (0, pad_x), (0, 0)), mode="reflect")

            patch_t = (
                torch.tensor(patch, dtype=torch.float32)
                .permute(2, 0, 1)
                .unsqueeze(0)
                .to(DEVICE)
            )
            with torch.no_grad():
                p = torch.sigmoid(model(patch_t))[0, 0].cpu().numpy()

            valid_h = y_end - y
            valid_w = x_end - x
            pred[y:y_end, x:x_end] += p[:valid_h, :valid_w]
            count[y:y_end, x:x_end] += 1

    pred = pred / count
    mask = np.array(Image.open(f"input/test/{fragment_id}/mask.png")) / 255.0
    return pred * mask

import os
import numpy as np
import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F
from torch.utils.data import Dataset, DataLoader
from tifffile import imread
from PIL import Image
import pandas as pd

# Config
SLICE_START = 27
NUM_SLICES = 11
PATCH_SIZE = 256
BATCH_SIZE = 32
EPOCHS = 5
THRESHOLD = 0.4
OVERLAP = 64
DEVICE = "cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu"


class TverskyLoss(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, alpha=0.7, beta=0.3, smooth=1e-6):
        super().__init__()
        self.alpha = alpha
        self.beta = beta
        self.smooth = smooth

    def forward(self, y_pred, y_true):
        y_pred = torch.sigmoid(y_pred)
        y_true = y_true.view(-1)
        y_pred = y_pred.view(-1)

        tp = (y_true * y_pred).sum()
        fp = ((1 - y_true) * y_pred).sum()
        fn = (y_true * (1 - y_pred)).sum()

        tversky = (tp + self.smooth) / (
            tp + self.alpha * fp + self.beta * fn + self.smooth
        )
        return 1 - tversky


class ScrollDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, fragments, is_train=True):
        self.is_train = is_train
        self.patches = []
        for frag in fragments:
            mask = np.array(Image.open(f"input/train/{frag}/mask.png"))
            label = np.array(Image.open(f"input/train/{frag}/inklabels.png"))

            slices = [
                imread(f"input/train/{frag}/surface_volume/{i:02}.tif")
                for i in range(SLICE_START, SLICE_START + NUM_SLICES)
            ]
            volume = np.stack(slices, axis=2)

            h, w = volume.shape[:2]
            for y in range(0, h, PATCH_SIZE // 2):
                for x in range(0, w, PATCH_SIZE // 2):
                    y_end = min(y + PATCH_SIZE, h)
                    x_end = min(x + PATCH_SIZE, w)
                    vol_patch = volume[y:y_end, x:x_end]
                    label_patch = label[y:y_end, x:x_end]

                    pad_y = PATCH_SIZE - (y_end - y)
                    pad_x = PATCH_SIZE - (x_end - x)

                    if pad_y > 0 or pad_x > 0:
                        vol_patch = np.pad(
                            vol_patch, ((0, pad_y), (0, pad_x), (0, 0)), mode="reflect"
                        )
                        label_patch = np.pad(
                            label_patch,
                            ((0, pad_y), (0, pad_x)),
                            mode="constant",
                            constant_values=0,
                        )

                    if self.is_train and (
                        label_patch.sum() == 0 and np.random.rand() > 0.1
                    ):
                        continue

                    self.patches.append(
                        (
                            torch.tensor(vol_patch, dtype=torch.float32).permute(
                                2, 0, 1
                            ),
                            torch.tensor(label_patch, dtype=torch.float32).unsqueeze(0),
                        )
                    )

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.patches)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        return self.patches[idx]


class DeepUNet(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        # Encoder
        self.enc1 = self._block(NUM_SLICES, 64)
        self.pool1 = nn.MaxPool2d(2)
        self.enc2 = self._block(64, 128)
        self.pool2 = nn.MaxPool2d(2)
        self.enc3 = self._block(128, 256)
        self.pool3 = nn.MaxPool2d(2)
        self.enc4 = self._block(256, 512)
        self.pool4 = nn.MaxPool2d(2)

        # Bridge
        self.bridge = self._block(512, 1024)

        # Decoder
        self.up4 = nn.ConvTranspose2d(1024, 512, 2, stride=2)
        self.dec4 = self._block(1024, 512)
        self.up3 = nn.ConvTranspose2d(512, 256, 2, stride=2)
        self.dec3 = self._block(512, 256)
        self.up2 = nn.ConvTranspose2d(256, 128, 2, stride=2)
        self.dec2 = self._block(256, 128)
        self.up1 = nn.ConvTranspose2d(128, 64, 2, stride=2)
        self.dec1 = self._block(128, 64)

        self.final = nn.Conv2d(64, 1, 1)

    def _block(self, in_c, out_c):
        return nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(in_c, out_c, 3, padding=1),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(out_c),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(out_c, out_c, 3, padding=1),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(out_c),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.2),
        )

    def forward(self, x):
        # Encoder
        e1 = self.enc1(x)
        e2 = self.enc2(self.pool1(e1))
        e3 = self.enc3(self.pool2(e2))
        e4 = self.enc4(self.pool3(e3))

        # Bridge
        b = self.bridge(self.pool4(e4))

        # Decoder
        d4 = self.up4(b)
        d4 = torch.cat([d4, e4], dim=1)
        d4 = self.dec4(d4)

        d3 = self.up3(d4)
        d3 = torch.cat([d3, e3], dim=1)
        d3 = self.dec3(d3)

        d2 = self.up2(d3)
        d2 = torch.cat([d2, e2], dim=1)
        d2 = self.dec2(d2)

        d1 = self.up1(d2)
        d1 = torch.cat([d1, e1], dim=1)
        d1 = self.dec1(d1)

        return self.final(d1)


def predict_fragment(model, fragment_id):
    model.eval()
    slices = [
        imread(f"input/test/{fragment_id}/surface_volume/{i:02}.tif")
        for i in range(SLICE_START, SLICE_START + NUM_SLICES)
    ]
    volume = np.stack(slices, axis=2)
    h, w = volume.shape[:2]
    pred = np.zeros((h, w), dtype=np.float32)
    count = np.zeros((h, w), dtype=np.float32)

    for y in range(0, h, OVERLAP):
        for x in range(0, w, OVERLAP):
            y_end = min(y + PATCH_SIZE, h)
            x_end = min(x + PATCH_SIZE, w)
            patch = volume[y:y_end, x:x_end]

            pad_y = PATCH_SIZE - (y_end - y)
            pad_x = PATCH_SIZE - (x_end - x)
            if pad_y > 0 or pad_x > 0:
                patch = np.pad(patch, ((0, pad_y), (0, pad_x), (0, 0)), mode="reflect")

            patch_t = (
                torch.tensor(patch, dtype=torch.float32)
                .permute(2, 0, 1)
                .unsqueeze(0)
                .to(DEVICE)
            )
            with torch.no_grad():
                p = torch.sigmoid(model(patch_t))[0, 0].cpu().numpy()

            valid_h = y_end - y
            valid_w = x_end - x
            pred[y:y_end, x:x_end] += p[:valid_h, :valid_w]
            count[y:y_end, x:x_end] += 1

    pred = pred / count
    mask = np.array(Image.open(f"input/test/{fragment_id}/mask.png")) / 255.0
    return pred * mask


def rle_encode(img):
    pixels = img.flatten()
    pixels = np.concatenate([[0], pixels, [0]])
    runs = np.where(pixels[1:] != pixels[:-1])[0] + 1
    runs[1::2] -= runs[::2]
    return " ".join(map(str, runs))

scheduler = torch.optim.lr_scheduler.ReduceLROnPlateau(
    optimizer, "max", patience=2, factor=0.5
)
criterion = TverskyLoss(alpha=0.7, beta=0.3)

train_ds = ScrollDataset(["1"], is_train=True)
val_ds = ScrollDataset(["2"], is_train=False)
train_loader = DataLoader(

)
val_loader = DataLoader(val_ds, batch_size=BATCH_SIZE, num_workers=4, pin_memory=True)

best_score = 0
for epoch in range(EPOCHS):
    # Training
    model.train()
    total_loss = 0
    for x, y in train_loader:
        x, y = x.to(DEVICE), y.to(DEVICE)
        optimizer.zero_grad()
        outputs = model(x)
        loss = criterion(outputs, y)
        loss.backward()
        optimizer.step()
        total_loss += loss.item()

    # Validation
    model.eval()
    val_preds, val_trues = [], []
    with torch.no_grad():
        for x, y in val_loader:
            x = x.to(DEVICE)
            outputs = torch.sigmoid(model(x))
            val_preds.append(outputs.cpu().numpy())
            val_trues.append(y.cpu().numpy())

    val_preds = np.concatenate(val_preds).flatten()
    val_trues = np.concatenate(val_trues).flatten()
    binary_preds = (val_preds > THRESHOLD).astype(float)

    tp = np.sum((binary_preds == 1) & (val_trues == 1))
    fp = np.sum((binary_preds == 1) & (val_trues == 0))
    fn = np.sum((binary_preds == 0) & (val_trues == 1))

    precision = tp / (tp + fp + 1e-6)
    recall = tp / (tp + fn + 1e-6)
    f05 = (1.25 * precision * recall) / (0.25 * precision + recall + 1e-6)

    scheduler.step(f05)
    print(
        f"Epoch {epoch+1}, Loss: {total_loss/len(train_loader):.4f}, Val F0.5: {f05:.4f}"
    )

    if f05 > best_score:
        best_score = f05
        torch.save(model.state_dict(), "best_model.pth")

# Generate submission
model.load_state_dict(torch.load("best_model.pth"))
submission = []
test_frags = [f for f in os.listdir("input/test") if os.path.isdir(f"input/test/{f}")]
for frag_id in test_frags:
    pred = predict_fragment(model, frag_id)
    binary = (pred > THRESHOLD).astype(np.uint8)

os.makedirs("submission", exist_ok=True)

                            torch.tensor(label_patch, dtype=torch.float32).unsqueeze(0),
                        )
                    )

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.patches)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        vol_patch, label_patch = self.patches[idx]
        if self.is_train:
            # Spatial augmentations
            angle = np.random.choice([0, 90, 180, 270])
            k = angle // 90
            if k != 0:
                vol_patch = torch.rot90(vol_patch, k, [-2, -1])
                label_patch = torch.rot90(label_patch, k, [-2, -1])

            if np.random.rand() < 0.5:
                vol_patch = torch.flip(vol_patch, [-1])
                label_patch = torch.flip(label_patch, [-1])
            if np.random.rand() < 0.5:
                vol_patch = torch.flip(vol_patch, [-2])
                label_patch = torch.flip(label_patch, [-2])

            # Intensity augmentations
            brightness = torch.normal(0.0, 0.1)
            contrast = torch.normal(1.0, 0.2)
            vol_patch = (vol_patch + brightness).clamp(0, 1)
            vol_patch = (vol_patch - 0.5) * contrast + 0.5
            vol_patch.clamp_(0, 1)

        return vol_patch, label_patch


class DeepUNet(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        # Encoder
        self.enc1 = self._block(NUM_SLICES, 64)
        self.pool1 = nn.MaxPool2d(2)
        self.enc2 = self._block(64, 128)
        self.pool2 = nn.MaxPool2d(2)
        self.enc3 = self._block(128, 256)
        self.pool3 = nn.MaxPool2d(2)
        self.enc4 = self._block(256, 512)
        self.pool4 = nn.MaxPool2d(2)

        # Bridge
        self.bridge = self._block(512, 1024)

        # Decoder
        self.up4 = nn.ConvTranspose2d(1024, 512, 2, stride=2)
        self.dec4 = self._block(1024, 512)
        self.up3 = nn.ConvTranspose2d(512, 256, 2, stride=2)
        self.dec3 = self._block(512, 256)
        self.up2 = nn.ConvTranspose2d(256, 128, 2, stride=2)
        self.dec2 = self._block(256, 128)
        self.up1 = nn.ConvTranspose2d(128, 64, 2, stride=2)
        self.dec1 = self._block(128, 64)

        self.final = nn.Conv2d(64, 1, 1)

    def _block(self, in_c, out_c):
        return nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(in_c, out_c, 3, padding=1),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(out_c),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(out_c, out_c, 3, padding=1),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(out_c),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.4),  # Increased dropout
        )

    def forward(self, x):
        e1 = self.enc1(x)
        e2 = self.enc2(self.pool1(e1))
        e3 = self.enc3(self.pool2(e2))
        e4 = self.enc4(self.pool3(e3))

        b = self.bridge(self.pool4(e4))

        d4 = self.up4(b)
        d4 = torch.cat([d4, e4], 1)
        d4 = self.dec4(d4)

        d3 = self.up3(d4)
        d3 = torch.cat([d3, e3], 1)
        d3 = self.dec3(d3)

        d2 = self.up2(d3)
        d2 = torch.cat([d2, e2], 1)
        d2 = self.dec2(d2)

        d1 = self.up1(d2)
        d1 = torch.cat([d1, e1], 1)
        d1 = self.dec1(d1)

        return self.final(d1)


def predict_fragment(model, fragment_id):
    model.eval()
    slices = [
        imread(f"input/test/{fragment_id}/surface_volume/{i:02}.tif")
        for i in range(SLICE_START, SLICE_START + NUM_SLICES)
    ]
    volume = np.stack(slices, axis=2).astype(np.float32) / 65535.0  # Normalize
    h, w = volume.shape[:2]
    pred = np.zeros((h, w), dtype=np.float32)
    count = np.zeros((h, w), dtype=np.float32)

    for y in range(0, h, OVERLAP):
        for x in range(0, w, OVERLAP):
            y_end = min(y + PATCH_SIZE, h)
            x_end = min(x + PATCH_SIZE, w)
            patch = volume[y:y_end, x:x_end]

            pad_y = PATCH_SIZE - (y_end - y)
            pad_x = PATCH_SIZE - (x_end - x)
            if pad_y > 0 or pad_x > 0:
                patch = np.pad(patch, ((0, pad_y), (0, pad_x), (0, 0)), mode="reflect")

            patch_t = (
                torch.tensor(patch, dtype=torch.float32)
                .permute(2, 0, 1)
                .unsqueeze(0)
                .to(DEVICE)
            )
            with torch.no_grad():
                p = torch.sigmoid(model(patch_t))[0, 0].cpu().numpy()

            valid_h = y_end - y
            valid_w = x_end - x
            pred[y:y_end, x:x_end] += p[:valid_h, :valid_w]
            count[y:y_end, x:x_end] += 1

    pred = pred / count
    mask = np.array(Image.open(f"input/test/{fragment_id}/mask.png")) / 255.0
    return pred * mask


def rle_encode(img):
    pixels = img.flatten()
    pixels = np.concatenate([[0], pixels, [0]])
    runs = np.where(pixels[1:] != pixels[:-1])[0] + 1
    runs[1::2] -= runs[::2]
    return " ".join(map(str, runs))

scheduler = torch.optim.lr_scheduler.ReduceLROnPlateau(

)
criterion = TverskyLoss(alpha=0.8, beta=0.2)

)
val_loader = DataLoader(val_ds, batch_size=BATCH_SIZE, num_workers=4, pin_memory=True)

best_score = 0
for epoch in range(EPOCHS):
    model.train()
    total_loss = 0
    for x, y in train_loader:
        x, y = x.to(DEVICE), y.to(DEVICE)
        optimizer.zero_grad()
        outputs = model(x)
        loss = criterion(outputs, y)
        loss.backward()
        optimizer.step()
        total_loss += loss.item()

    model.eval()
    val_preds, val_trues = [], []
    with torch.no_grad():
        for x, y in val_loader:
            x = x.to(DEVICE)
            outputs = torch.sigmoid(model(x))
            val_preds.append(outputs.cpu().numpy())
            val_trues.append(y.cpu().numpy())

    val_preds = np.concatenate(val_preds).flatten()
    val_trues = np.concatenate(val_trues).flatten()
    binary_preds = (val_preds > THRESHOLD).astype(float)

    tp = np.sum((binary_preds == 1) & (val_trues == 1))
    fp = np.sum((binary_preds == 1) & (val_trues == 0))
    fn = np.sum((binary_preds == 0) & (val_trues == 1))

    precision = tp / (tp + fp + 1e-6)
    recall = tp / (tp + fn + 1e-6)
    f05 = (1.25 * precision * recall) / (0.25 * precision + recall + 1e-6)

    scheduler.step(f05)
    print(
        f"Epoch {epoch+1}, Loss: {total_loss/len(train_loader):.4f}, Val F0.5: {f05:.4f}"
    )

    if f05 > best_score:

class PapyrusDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, frag_dirs, transform=None):
        self.transform = transform
        self.images = []
        self.targets = []
        self.masks = []

        for dir in frag_dirs:
            # Cast slices to float32 immediately after loading
            slices = [
                tifffile.imread(p).astype(np.float32)
                for p in sorted(glob.glob(f"{dir}/surface_volume/*.tif"))
            ][25:40]

            # Compute gradients using float32
            grad_mags = [
                np.sqrt(
                    cv2.Sobel(s, cv2.CV_32F, 1, 0, ksize=3) ** 2
                    + cv2.Sobel(s, cv2.CV_32F, 0, 1, ksize=3) ** 2
                )
                for s in slices
            ]

            features = [
                np.mean(slices, axis=0),
                np.max(slices, axis=0),
                np.std(slices, axis=0),
                np.mean(grad_mags, axis=0),
            ]

            # Normalize features
            for arr in features:
                arr -= arr.mean()
                arr /= arr.std()

            image = np.stack(features, axis=-1)
            mask = cv2.imread(f"{dir}/mask.png", 0) > 0
            target = (
                cv2.imread(f"{dir}/inklabels.png", 0).astype(np.float32)
                if "train" in dir
                else None
            )

            H, W = image.shape[:2]
            pad_h = (patch_size - H % patch_size) % patch_size
            pad_w = (patch_size - W % patch_size) % patch_size

            image = np.pad(image, ((0, pad_h), (0, pad_w), (0, 0)))
            mask = np.pad(mask, ((0, pad_h), (0, pad_w)))
            if target is not None:
                target = np.pad(target, ((0, pad_h), (0, pad_w)))

            self.images.append(image)
            self.masks.append(mask)
            if target is not None:
                self.targets.append(target)

            self.coords = []
            for i in range(0, image.shape[0], patch_size):
                for j in range(0, image.shape[1], patch_size):
                    if mask[i : i + patch_size, j : j + patch_size].any():
                        self.coords.append((i, j))

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.coords)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        i, j = self.coords[idx]
        img = self.images[0][i : i + patch_size, j : j + patch_size]
        mask = self.masks[0][i : i + patch_size, j : j + patch_size]
        target = (
            self.targets[0][i : i + patch_size, j : j + patch_size]
            if self.targets
            else np.zeros_like(mask)
        )

        if self.transform:
            transformed = self.transform(image=img, mask=target)
            img = transformed["image"]
            target = transformed["mask"]
        else:
            img = torch.tensor(img).permute(2, 0, 1).float()
            target = torch.tensor(target).float()

        return img, target, mask

import os
import numpy as np
import torch
import torch.nn as nn
from torch.utils.data import Dataset, DataLoader
from tifffile import imread
from PIL import Image
import pandas as pd

# Config
SLICE_START = 27
NUM_SLICES = 11
PATCH_SIZE = 256
BATCH_SIZE = 32
EPOCHS = 5
THRESHOLD = 0.4
OVERLAP = 64
DEVICE = "cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu"


class TverskyLoss(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, alpha=0.8, beta=0.2, smooth=1e-6):
        super().__init__()
        self.alpha = alpha
        self.beta = beta
        self.smooth = smooth

    def forward(self, y_pred, y_true):
        y_pred = torch.sigmoid(y_pred)
        y_true = y_true.view(-1)
        y_pred = y_pred.view(-1)

        tp = (y_true * y_pred).sum()
        fp = ((1 - y_true) * y_pred).sum()
        fn = (y_true * (1 - y_pred)).sum()

        tversky = (tp + self.smooth) / (
            tp + self.alpha * fp + self.beta * fn + self.smooth
        )
        return 1 - tversky


class ScrollDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, fragments, is_train=True):
        self.is_train = is_train
        self.patches = []
        for frag in fragments:
            mask = np.array(Image.open(f"input/train/{frag}/mask.png"))
            label = np.array(Image.open(f"input/train/{frag}/inklabels.png"))

            slices = [
                imread(f"input/train/{frag}/surface_volume/{i:02}.tif")
                for i in range(SLICE_START, SLICE_START + NUM_SLICES)
            ]
            volume = np.stack(slices, axis=2)

            h, w = volume.shape[:2]
            for y in range(0, h, PATCH_SIZE // 2):
                for x in range(0, w, PATCH_SIZE // 2):
                    y_end = min(y + PATCH_SIZE, h)
                    x_end = min(x + PATCH_SIZE, w)
                    vol_patch = volume[y:y_end, x:x_end].astype(np.float32) / 65535.0
                    label_patch = label[y:y_end, x:x_end]

                    pad_y = PATCH_SIZE - (y_end - y)
                    pad_x = PATCH_SIZE - (x_end - x)
                    if pad_y > 0 or pad_x > 0:
                        vol_patch = np.pad(
                            vol_patch, ((0, pad_y), (0, pad_x), (0, 0)), mode="reflect"
                        )
                        label_patch = np.pad(
                            label_patch,
                            ((0, pad_y), (0, pad_x)),
                            mode="constant",
                            constant_values=0,
                        )

                    if self.is_train and (
                        label_patch.sum() == 0 and np.random.rand() > 0.1
                    ):
                        continue

                    self.patches.append(
                        (
                            torch.tensor(vol_patch, dtype=torch.float32).permute(
                                2, 0, 1
                            ),
                            torch.tensor(label_patch, dtype=torch.float32).unsqueeze(0),
                        )
                    )

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.patches)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        vol_patch, label_patch = self.patches[idx]
        if self.is_train:
            # Spatial augmentations
            if np.random.rand() < 0.5:
                vol_patch = torch.flip(vol_patch, [-1])
                label_patch = torch.flip(label_patch, [-1])
            if np.random.rand() < 0.5:
                vol_patch = torch.flip(vol_patch, [-2])
                label_patch = torch.flip(label_patch, [-2])
            angle = np.random.choice([0, 90, 180, 270])
            if angle != 0:
                vol_patch = torch.rot90(vol_patch, angle // 90, [-2, -1])
                label_patch = torch.rot90(label_patch, angle // 90, [-2, -1])

            # Fix: Use numpy for random generation
            brightness = np.random.normal(0, 0.1)
            contrast = np.random.normal(1.0, 0.2)
            vol_patch = (vol_patch + brightness).clamp(0, 1)
            vol_patch = (vol_patch - 0.5) * contrast + 0.5
            vol_patch.clamp_(0, 1)

        return vol_patch, label_patch


class DeepUNet(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.enc1 = self._block(NUM_SLICES, 64)
        self.pool1 = nn.MaxPool2d(2)
        self.enc2 = self._block(64, 128)
        self.pool2 = nn.MaxPool2d(2)
        self.enc3 = self._block(128, 256)
        self.pool3 = nn.MaxPool2d(2)
        self.enc4 = self._block(256, 512)
        self.pool4 = nn.MaxPool2d(2)
        self.bridge = self._block(512, 1024)
        self.up4 = nn.ConvTranspose2d(1024, 512, 2, stride=2)
        self.dec4 = self._block(1024, 512)
        self.up3 = nn.ConvTranspose2d(512, 256, 2, stride=2)
        self.dec3 = self._block(512, 256)
        self.up2 = nn.ConvTranspose2d(256, 128, 2, stride=2)
        self.dec2 = self._block(256, 128)
        self.up1 = nn.ConvTranspose2d(128, 64, 2, stride=2)
        self.dec1 = self._block(128, 64)
        self.final = nn.Conv2d(64, 1, 1)

    def _block(self, in_c, out_c):
        return nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(in_c, out_c, 3, padding=1),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(out_c),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(out_c, out_c, 3, padding=1),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(out_c),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.4),
        )

    def forward(self, x):
        e1 = self.enc1(x)
        e2 = self.enc2(self.pool1(e1))
        e3 = self.enc3(self.pool2(e2))
        e4 = self.enc4(self.pool3(e3))
        b = self.bridge(self.pool4(e4))
        d4 = self.up4(b)
        d4 = torch.cat([d4, e4], 1)
        d4 = self.dec4(d4)
        d3 = self.up3(d4)
        d3 = torch.cat([d3, e3], 1)
        d3 = self.dec3(d3)
        d2 = self.up2(d3)
        d2 = torch.cat([d2, e2], 1)
        d2 = self.dec2(d2)
        d1 = self.up1(d2)
        d1 = torch.cat([d1, e1], 1)
        d1 = self.dec1(d1)
        return self.final(d1)
